author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Receives verified Ko-fi donations through Streamer.bot and shows each one once as a StreamBridge alert. Donations are saved first so a hiccup does not lose them. Includes privacy controls.
changelog: 4.1.61: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.61, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 1.0.1: reorganized setup into short guided sections, added the required Streamer.bot-first checklist, and linked alert/chat presentation controls. 1.0.0: initial stable-ID Ko-fi donation intake.

manifest.name: Ko-fi Donations
installationSteps: Connect Ko-fi to Streamer.bot using Streamer.bot Website Webhooks and the Ko-fi verification token.
Include Ko-fi Donations in the universal Streamer.bot import and attach Ko-Fi > Donation to its Intake action.
Open Alerts > Donation provider setup, choose your privacy settings, turn on Ko-fi donations, and restart StreamBridge.
uninstallationSteps: Turn off Ko-fi donations in Alerts. The integration remains available with StreamBridge and stores no Ko-fi webhook secrets or payment history.

healthChecks.description: Checks that Ko-fi donations with a valid ID can reach your alerts and are saved until shown.
